name: A1 document-aware menus, A2 toolbar and E1 shell honesty
description: Opens an isolated software fixture project, then every application menu with the schematic and then the PCB as the active document (Phase 1 A1: menus come from the action registry and change with the document). Then the A2 toolbar: icon buttons, the grid/unit/snap combos of each editor (unit and grid size changed through their View menu entries, which write the same per-editor store as the combos; snap toggled by an XTest click on its check box), a split-button dropdown whose pick becomes the main button, and View > Toolbar labels. Then E1 (dead-control sweep): removed placeholders are absent from the toolbar and menus, the Saved badge reports the engine state, the menu bar moves with the arrow keys, the status bar shows a copper layer only in the PCB editor, View > Show <view> shows (twice stays shown), Help lists the generated shortcuts and About shows the version (both close on Escape), and Library / Parts says the distributor is not configured.
